skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals a 2-hit combo to a single target, each hit dealing 120% ATK DMG.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals a 5-hit combo to all enemies, each hit inflicting 5000% ATK [Specialized Direct DMG] (only affected by advanced DMG modifiers). Ignores 45% [Specialized Dodge] and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction], and pierces through [Unyielding] and [Specialized Unyielding].

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals a 5-hit combo to all enemies, each hit inflicting 7000% ATK [Specialized Direct DMG] (only affected by advanced DMG modifiers). Ignores 60% [Specialized Dodge] and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction], and pierces through [Unyielding] and [Specialized Unyielding]. Increases own Crit Rate by 30% for 1 turn. If ATK is higher than the target’s, there is a 130% chance to reduce the target’s [Specialized HP DMG Reduction] by 3% for 4 turns.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains 60% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]. When the number of attack targets is 2 or fewer, [Specialized Direct DMG] is increased by 30%.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains 70% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]. When the number of attack targets is 2 or fewer, [Specialized Direct DMG] is increased by 40%.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains 80% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]. When the number of attack targets is 2 or fewer, [Specialized Direct DMG] is increased by 50%.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: At the start of battle, gains 30% [Suppression Guard]. Allies (including self) with [Suppression Guard] also gain 30% [Suppression Boost]. [Suppression Guard]: Reduces DMG taken by 40%. If own Attack is higher than the attacker’s, the DMG reduction is increased to 1.5x. [Suppression Boost]: Increases DMG dealt by 40%. If own Attack is higher than the target’s, the DMG boost is increased to 1.5x.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: At the start of battle, gains 40% [Suppression Guard]. Allies (including self) with [Suppression Guard] also gain 40% [Suppression Boost]. [Suppression Guard]: Reduces DMG taken by 40%. If own Attack is higher than the attacker’s, the DMG reduction is increased to 1.7x. [Suppression Boost]: Increases DMG dealt by 40%. If own Attack is higher than the target’s, the DMG boost is increased to 1.7x.

effects.desc: The defensive effect reduces damage taken (30–40%), increasing to a 150–170% reduction when the bearer's ST is higher than the attacker's.
Attack buff gives 30-40% mana and increases damage, increasing by 150-170% when the bearer's Attack is higher than the target.
